title: Helena, MT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Helena is a city in MT with a population of 33,000. Montana’s capital with the Cathedral of St. Helena, Last Chance Gulch, and mountain access. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
